configuration_boundary.actuation_route: LowCmd joint-level control synthesized by AutoAdapter capabilities
configuration_boundary.source_interpretation: Official high-level examples establish task concepts only. The General Demo must synthesize behavior through the admitted low-level SDK route.

difficulty_policy: All 26 task descriptions and exact-configuration applicability decisions are human approved. No ordinal Go2 difficulty level is assigned; each record retains only its approved qualitative rationale.

tasks.description: Stand up from the specified supported starting posture and hold a stable upright stance.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: A single posture transition with a stationary terminal state.

tasks.description: Sit down from a stable standing posture and hold the supported sitting posture without falling.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: A controlled lowering transition with a stationary terminal state.

tasks.description: Maintain a stable upright stance at the current location for the requested interval.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Stationary posture maintenance without a commanded displacement.

tasks.description: Move forward in the robot's initial heading direction, then stop in a stable upright stance.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: One straight translation followed by a controlled stop.

tasks.description: Adjust the robot body to the specified target height and hold it upright at the current location.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Requires coordinated whole-body posture adjustment while constraining orientation and drift.

tasks.description: Move backward in the robot's initial heading frame, then stop in a stable upright stance.
tasks.adaptation_note: Use the initial-body-yaw frame and the admitted low-level route; no high-level Move call is permitted.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: A reverse translation adds braking and heading control without adding terrain complexity.

tasks.description: Move left in the robot's initial heading frame, then stop in a stable upright stance.
tasks.adaptation_note: Evaluate lateral displacement in the initial-body-yaw frame and synthesize all leg behavior from LowCmd.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Lateral translation requires coordinated stepping while holding forward position and heading.

tasks.description: Move right in the robot's initial heading frame, then stop in a stable upright stance.
tasks.adaptation_note: Mirror the leftward task semantically, but preserve a separate robot-conditioned execution and evaluation record.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Lateral translation requires coordinated stepping while holding forward position and heading.

tasks.description: Turn in place to the specified yaw heading and stop upright.
tasks.adaptation_note: The task target is semantic yaw; capability generation must decide how to synthesize it from joint-level commands.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Primarily commands yaw while constraining unintended translation and roll/pitch motion.

tasks.description: Track the specified forward, lateral, and yaw velocity command for the requested interval.
tasks.adaptation_note: Command bounds and evaluation windows must be selected for this exact Go2 LowCmd/MuJoCo route rather than copied from training environments.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Simultaneously tracks three planar velocity components over time.

tasks.description: Visit the specified ordered sequence of planar waypoints and finish upright at the final waypoint.
tasks.adaptation_note: Waypoints and their ordering are public task state; any trajectory-follow API remains provenance only.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Requires multiple sequential spatial goals and a stable terminal state.

tasks.description: Stop from the specified ongoing planar motion and settle into a stable upright stance.
tasks.adaptation_note: The initial motion is established by the trusted Harness before capability invocation; StopMove is not callable by the generated implementation.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Requires deceleration and balance recovery from a nonstationary initial state.

tasks.description: Adjust to the specified body roll while maintaining support and location.
tasks.adaptation_note: The approved roll range must respect the exact morphology and support constraints; Euler/BalanceAttitude calls are not available to the implementation.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Changes one body attitude axis while constraining translation and support loss.

tasks.description: Adjust to the specified body pitch while maintaining support and location.
tasks.adaptation_note: The approved pitch range must respect the exact morphology and support constraints; Euler/BalanceAttitude calls are provenance only.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Changes one body attitude axis while constraining translation and support loss.

tasks.description: Recover from the specified permitted fallen starting pose to a stable upright stance.
tasks.adaptation_note: Only explicitly admitted initial poses may be used; source robots and self-righting protocols are not assumed equivalent to Go2.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: A large contact-rich whole-body transition whose feasibility depends on the initial-pose set.

tasks.description: Maintain and recover the specified stance after the declared external planar disturbance.
tasks.adaptation_note: The trusted Harness applies a frozen disturbance; candidate code cannot choose or observe hidden evaluation parameters.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Tests balance recovery from an externally imposed perturbation rather than nominal tracking alone.

tasks.description: Traverse the specified irregular rough-terrain segment and finish upright in the goal region.
tasks.adaptation_note: Terrain geometry and seeds require new frozen scene assets; source training ranges are not evaluation thresholds.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Irregular support heights require continuing foothold and body stabilization.

tasks.description: Ascend the specified slope and finish upright on its goal platform.
tasks.adaptation_note: Slope geometry and friction must be frozen for the Go2 MuJoCo scene before admission.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Changes gravitational loading and pitch demands throughout locomotion.

tasks.description: Descend the specified slope and finish upright on its goal platform.
tasks.adaptation_note: Use a separately reviewed downhill task because braking and impact risks differ from ascent.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Requires controlled braking and posture regulation under downhill loading.

tasks.description: Traverse the specified staircase and finish upright on its goal platform.
tasks.adaptation_note: Stair direction, geometry, friction, and collision assets must be frozen; ascent and descent may be split during human review.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Repeated discrete elevation changes impose foothold, clearance, and impact constraints.

tasks.description: Traverse the specified sparse box-and-step field and finish upright in the goal region.
tasks.adaptation_note: Requires a new frozen scene asset and an approved public representation of obstacle geometry for the no-camera configuration.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Irregular discrete supports require clearance, foothold selection, and balance.

tasks.description: Weave through the specified ordered poles and stop upright in the goal region.
tasks.adaptation_note: Adapt the Barkour weave-poles concept to Go2 dimensions; do not inherit Barkour geometry, scoring, or timing. The current no-camera configuration needs an approved public pole-state representation.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Requires repeated direction changes, collision avoidance, and ordered progress through a constrained path.

tasks.description: Traverse the specified A-frame obstacle and stop upright in the goal region.
tasks.adaptation_note: Adapt only the obstacle concept. Go2-specific geometry, friction, observation, and safety limits require separate review and scene admission.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Combines steep ascent, crest transition, descent, and terminal balance.

tasks.description: Cross the specified broad-jump obstacle and land in a stable upright state in the goal region.
tasks.adaptation_note: The source tasks use different robots and perception. Go2-specific gap geometry, takeoff state, landing surface, and safety envelope must be independently piloted and approved.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: A dynamic flight and landing task with tight safety and morphology dependence.

tasks.description: Cross the specified high obstacle and land in a stable upright state in the goal region.
tasks.adaptation_note: Extreme Parkour establishes a task concept, not Go2 feasibility. The current robot configuration lacks the paper's front depth camera, so admission requires an approved public geometry representation or a distinct sensor configuration.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Highly dynamic clearance and landing behavior with strong perception and morphology dependencies.

tasks.description: Complete the specified ordered quadruped agility course and stop upright in the final goal region.
tasks.adaptation_note: This is a future compound task. Each obstacle, transition, observation, safety rule, and Go2-specific scoring rule must first be separately admitted.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Composes multiple locomotion and agility skills with ordering and transition constraints.
